# TASK 1 — Current-state map: session-tool wire names across Pi / Claude / Codex

## Headline correction to the prior analysis' premise

The premise "Pi sends BARE names" does **not** match HEAD. Pi's **model-facing wire name** is `mcp__session__<snake_case descriptorId>` — minted by `sessionBinding()` (`packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/harness-tool-descriptor.ts:253-259`, `piName = 'mcp__session__' + descriptorId`) and installed as the model-visible name by `projectPiToolDefinition` (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/harness/tool-manifest.ts:388` — `name: tool.binding.piName`), then registered via `sessionOptions.customTools`/`tools` (`packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:2019-2059`). Bare names (`TodoWrite`, `SlashCommand`, `BashOutput`, `source_manage`) exist on Pi only at the **permission/hook layer** — `pre_tool_use_request` carries `toolName: tool.binding.permissionName` (bare registry id; `packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:2281-2287`) — and in the **UI transcript** after `mcp__session__` is stripped (`packages/ui/src/lib/tool-parsers.ts:433`; also `packages/shared/src/agent/browser-tool-names.ts:38`; `packages/pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:2916-2917` accepts legacy `session__` too). The prior analysis almost certainly measured one of those layers.

So the real divergence is **three different prefixed spellings**, not bare-vs-prefixed:
- **Pi**: `mcp__session__<snake_case>` (e.g. `mcp__session__todo_write`)
- **Claude**: `mcp__session__<registry id verbatim>` (e.g. `mcp__session__TodoWrite`)
- **Codex**: `mcp__nessy_session__<registry id verbatim>` (e.g. `mcp__nessy_session__TodoWrite`) — server segment differs from Claude

## Mint sites

**Pi** (two names, both host-minted):
1. Host → subprocess proxy defs: `getSessionToolProxyDefs()` (`packages/shared/src/agent/backend/pi/session-tool-defs.ts:34-40`) = `getToolDefsAsJsonSchema({ prefix: 'mcp__session__', projection: 'pi' })` (`packages/session-tools-core/src/tool-defs.ts:1447-1473`) → **bindingName** = `mcp__session__<registry id verbatim>` (e.g. `mcp__session__SubmitPlan`). Filtered/consumed in `PiAgent.buildCurrentProxyToolDefinitions` (`packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:1682-1734`).
2. Model-facing rename: the manifest binding table `PI_TOOL_BINDINGS` (`harness-tool-descriptor.ts:261-363`) pairs each with **piName** = `mcp__session__<descriptorId>` (snake_case), and `projectPiToolDefinition` (`tool-manifest.ts:359-397`) renames the definition to piName before the Pi SDK sees it (`harness-manifest.ts:527` does the same for ports). The manifest lookup accepts **both** spellings as `presentedName` (`tool-manifest.ts:39-58`). **Not the registry id verbatim** for 22 CamelCase tools — it is the snake_case transform.

**Claude**: `getSessionScopedTools` (`packages/shared/src/agent/session-scoped-tools.ts:209-335`) → `tool(def.name, …)` with the **registry id verbatim** (`:266-284`), plus backend extras `call_llm` (`llm-tool.ts:563-564`), `spawn_session` (`spawn-session-tool.ts:70-72`), `browser_tool` (`browser-tools.ts:244-245`), wrapped in `createSdkMcpServer({ name: 'session' })` (`:330-334`) → SDK mints `mcp__session__<registry id verbatim>`. Confirmed: the `<tool>` segment is the registry id byte-for-byte.

**Codex**: a **different path from Claude** — no SDK server. `CodexAgent.buildSessionMcpSpec` (`packages/shared/src/agent/codex-agent.ts:182-204`) spawns the bundled `session-mcp-server` with `--external-standalone-only`, registered in codex config as `[mcp_servers.nessy_session]` (`packages/codex-responses-adapter/src/config-writer.ts:613`). The server advertises **bare registry ids** (`packages/session-mcp-server/src/index.ts:229-238`, `name: def.name`, no prefix), and the codex binary mints the model-facing name as `mcp__<serverKey>__<tool>` → `mcp__nessy_session__<registry id>` (documented + reproduced at `packages/shared/src/agent/backend/codex/event-adapter.ts:124-148`, `mcpRowToolName`). Segment matches the registry id verbatim; the **server segment does not match Claude's** (`nessy_session` vs `session`). Note: `tool-parsers.ts:433` strips only `mcp__session__`, so Codex transcript rows keep the full `mcp__nessy_session__…` spelling.

## Per-runtime visibility summary (changes the unification surface)

- **Pi-only (17)**: Task, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, TaskGet, TaskList, GoalGet, Goal, Monitor, EnterWorktree, ExitWorktree, list_mcp_resources, read_mcp_resource, PushNotification, CronCreate, CronList, CronDelete, ScheduleWakeup — several deliberately (Monitor/EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree are security-gated on the Pi permission gate; `tool-defs.ts:1083-1095`).
- **Claude+Codex only**: TodoWrite (suppressed on Pi when task tools are on, `tool-defs.ts:1330`). No strictly Claude-only tool exists; Claude = everything non-pi-only.
- **Codex** = the 18-tool `externalStandaloneOnly` subset (registry handlers with no host callback); the server also refuses host-callback tools at call time (`session-mcp-server/src/index.ts:454`).

## Segment mismatches beyond the (nonexistent) bare-vs-prefixed split

1. **Pi vs Claude segment casing**: 22 tools whose registry id is CamelCase get snake_case on Pi (SubmitPlan/TodoWrite/Task*/Goal*/SlashCommand/BashOutput/ProcessStop/Monitor/EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree/ReportFindings/PushNotification/SendUserFile/Cron*/ScheduleWakeup). snake_case registry ids match exactly.
2. **Codex server segment**: `nessy_session` vs `session` — every Codex name differs from Claude's, and `tool-parsers.ts:433` won't strip it in the UI.
3. **Pi dual internal spelling**: host↔subprocess IPC uses bindingName `mcp__session__<RegistryId>` while the model sees piName `mcp__session__<snake>`; the manifest treats both as valid `presentedName` (`tool-manifest.ts:39-58`, `harness-manifest.ts:596,614`), and description text is rewritten bindingName→piName via `PI_TOOL_PRESENTATION_REWRITES` (`tool-manifest.ts:329-364`).
4. **Pi permission/hook layer is bare**: rules/hooks match `permissionName` = registry id (`harness-tool-descriptor.ts:253-259` fifth arg; `pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:2281`), unlike Claude where rules must match the full `mcp__session__X` spelling.
5. **Legacy `session__` (no `mcp__`) ingress** still accepted: `pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:2916-2917`, `browser-tool-names.ts:38` — old transcripts only, nothing mints it today.

Implication for the plan: unifying on `mcp__session__<registry id verbatim>` requires (a) Pi: make `sessionBinding` piName use the registry id segment instead of the snake_case descriptorId (regenerating `PI_STATIC_MODEL_CONTRACT_HASHES` pins and the presentation-rewrite pins), and (b) Codex: rename the config server key `nessy_session` → `session` (`config-writer.ts:613`, `codex-agent.ts:176`, `event-adapter.ts:138` comment) — not a session-mcp-server change, since it already serves registry ids verbatim.

# TASK 2 — Blast-radius audit: renaming Pi session tools to `mcp__session__<tool>`

## HEADLINE CORRECTION — the premise is stale; the rename is ~90% already shipped

**Pi does NOT send bare session-tool names. It already sends `mcp__session__<tool>` — on `master` (1.25.1), not just this branch.** The model-facing name is set at `packages/pi-agent-server/src/harness/tool-manifest.ts:388` (`name: tool.binding.piName`), and `piName` for every session tool is minted `mcp__session__${descriptorId}` by `sessionBinding()` at `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/harness-tool-descriptor.ts:253-259`. `git show master:` confirms this predates the branch.

The **actual** divergence is the **suffix**, not bare-vs-prefixed:

| Function | Claude / Codex (SDK/adapter mint) | Pi (piName) | Diverges? |
|---|---|---|---|
| source_manage, config_validate, transform_data, call_llm, plugin_*, automation_*, set_session_*, browser_tool, … (~28 snake-named) | `mcp__session__source_manage` | `mcp__session__source_manage` | **NO — already identical** |
| SubmitPlan, TodoWrite, SlashCommand, BashOutput, ProcessStop, ReportFindings, SendUserFile (7, cross-runtime-visible) | `mcp__session__TodoWrite` | `mcp__session__todo_write` | **YES — casing** |
| Task, TaskCreate/Update/Get/List, Goal, GoalGet, Monitor, EnterWorktree, ExitWorktree, PushNotification, CronCreate/List/Delete, ScheduleWakeup (15, `visibility: 'pi-only'`) | (not emitted by Claude/Codex) | `mcp__session__todo_write`-style snake | casing, Pi-only |

Why: Claude registers `tool(def.name, …)` inside `createSdkMcpServer({name:'session'})` (`session-scoped-tools.ts:266-284,330`), where `def.name` is the canonical `SESSION_TOOL_DEFS` spelling (`TodoWrite`, `SlashCommand`, …). Pi's `piName` uses `descriptorId` (snake). **So "make Pi 1:1 with the SDK form" = change `sessionBinding`'s `piName` from `mcp__session__${descriptorId}` to `mcp__session__${handlerName}` (the PascalCase spelling), for the ~22 divergent tools.** That is a one-line change in `harness-tool-descriptor.ts` plus its blast radius below.

⚠️ **Codex may be a THIRD divergence, contradicting the task premise.** Codex does not use the Claude SDK `session` server — it mounts the bundled stdio `session-mcp-server` as **`[mcp_servers.nessy_session]`** (`codex-responses-adapter/src/config-writer.ts:613`, `codex-agent.ts:176`), and that server registers tools under `def.name` (`session-mcp-server/src/index.ts:235`). No `nessy_session`→`session` remap exists (grep clean). So Codex's wire prefix is plausibly `mcp__nessy_session__TodoWrite`, i.e. its **server segment** differs from Claude's `session`. This needs its own verification, but if true, "identical across all three" requires aligning the **Codex config key** too, not just Pi's casing. Flag for the plan.

---

## Consumer-by-consumer blast radius (change = piName suffix snake→Pascal)

### SEV-1 (HARD backward-compat risk) — old Pi transcripts on disk

- **`packages/pi-agent-server/src/compat/pi-legacy-ingress.ts:5-13`** — `TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` currently normalizes **Pascal→snake** (`mcp__session__SubmitPlan → mcp__session__submit_plan`, + TodoWrite/Task/SlashCommand/BashOutput) on replayed Pi SDK history. **Breakage:** the map's direction is *backwards* for the new world. Old `.pi-sessions/*.jsonl` transcripts recorded the snake piName in their `toolCall` blocks; after the rename the live tool is `mcp__session__SubmitPlan`, so replayed history carrying `mcp__session__submit_plan` no longer matches the advertised name, and the model sees a snake/Pascal split across turns. The map is also **incomplete** — it lists only 5 of the ~22 divergent tools (missing ProcessStop, ReportFindings, SendUserFile, PushNotification, Cron*, Monitor, Enter/ExitWorktree, Goal*, Task*). **Mitigation (turns HARD→SOFT):** invert every entry (snake→Pascal) and extend to the full divergent set, so old transcripts normalize forward on resume. This file is the single load-bearing backward-compat seam — get it right and disk transcripts stop being a hard break.

### SEV-2 (controlled but wide) — the manifest-resolution union rule and its guard test

- **`packages/pi-agent-server/src/harness/tool-manifest.ts` `findPiManifestToolsByPresentedName`** (referenced from `index.ts:2260` comment, used by `findManifestToolByPresentedName`) resolves a presented name by matching **either** `binding.piName` **or** `binding.bindingName`. Today piName=`mcp__session__submit_plan`, bindingName=`mcp__session__SubmitPlan` — the union is what lets both spellings resolve. **After the rename piName == bindingName**, so the union collapses harmlessly (both point to the same string). **No breakage**, but…
- **`packages/pi-agent-server/src/__tests__/pi-runtime-protocol.test.ts:218-235`** — a golden test whose comment asserts *"Session bindings diverge on purpose (piName `mcp__session__submit_plan` vs bindingName `mcp__session__SubmitPlan`)"*. **Breakage:** the stated invariant becomes false; the test's rationale must be rewritten (the union rule still needs to exist for raw-proxy MCP tools, but the session-tool example no longer diverges). Controlled edit, not a wall.

### SEV-2 — the definition lookup keys on `bindingName`, not `piName`

- **`tool-manifest.ts:287`** — `definitions.get(tool.binding.bindingName)`. bindingName is **already** `mcp__session__SubmitPlan` (Pascal) and is **unchanged** by the rename. **No breakage** — this is why the change is small: the internal registration key already uses the Pascal spelling; only the model-facing projection (`piName`) is snake. Confirms the rename is projection-only.

### SEV-3 (golden-string wall, ~10 test files) — controlled literal updates

Tests hardcoding the snake piName that must flip to Pascal (mechanical, but a green-run gate):
- `packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/whole-tool-deny-manifest.test.ts:184` (`toContain('mcp__session__todo_write')`)
- `packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/pi-agent-orchestration.test.ts`
- `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/harness-manifest.test.ts:222` (asserts `piName === 'mcp__session__submit_plan'` maps to `bindingId: 'mcp__session__SubmitPlan'`)
- `packages/pi-agent-server/src/harness/tool-manifest.test.ts:384,393,408,426,431` (`mcp__session__bash_output`)
- `packages/pi-agent-server/src/context-usage.categories.test.ts:82`, `context-categories.suggestions.test.ts:48` (`mcp__session__submit_plan`)
- `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.test.ts`
- `packages/pi-agent-server/src/compat/pi-legacy-ingress.test.ts:15`
- `packages/pi-agent-server/src/orchestrator/runtime-agent-definitions.test.ts:490,510,535`

Because these all assert against the **static registry**, the rename regenerates them predictably — a controlled update, ~10 files, not surprise failures. (Note: `runtime-agent-definitions.test.ts` and `runtime-agent-definition.ts` are already modified in the working tree on this branch — coordinate by-file per the concurrent-edit trap.)

### SEV-4 (already robust — verify, don't fix)

- **Model-contract hash / manifest digest** — session tools are **NOT** in `PI_STATIC_MODEL_CONTRACT_HASHES` (`harness-tool-descriptor.ts:49-77` lists only `read`…`mcp__tool_load`). Their `modelContractHash` is computed per-session via `hashProjectedPiToolDefinition` (`tool-manifest.ts:397-411`), which hashes `projected.name` (=piName). Host and subprocess both compute from the same registry, so the hash moves **consistently on both sides** — no "manifest model contract mismatch" wall, no static pin to re-pin. **This is the key reason the rename is low-risk.** Only regenerate any snapshot/digest fixture that embeds a session-tool hash.
- **Permissions** — `permissions-config.ts:529` parses rules against `PERMISSION_RULE_TOOL_NAMES`, built from `permissionName` + `descriptorId` (`harness-tool-descriptor.ts:381-383`), **never `piName`**. Permission receipts resolve via `presentedName → findManifestToolByPresentedName → permissionName`. **Insulated** — no rule pattern matches `piName`, so user/config permission rules are unaffected.
- **pre-tool-use classifiers** (`packages/shared/src/agent/core/pre-tool-use.ts`) — the auto-mode set (lines 125-138: `'TodoWrite'`,`'SubmitPlan'`,`'SlashCommand'`,`'TaskStop'`) is fed the **policy name** (`permissionName`), explicitly per the comment at 145 — unaffected. The name-literal sets already carry **both** forms where they diverge: `ENTER_WORKTREE_TOOLS` (877-878) lists `mcp__session__EnterWorktree` AND `mcp__session__enter_worktree`; `INTERACTION_ONLY_TOOLS`/`WORKFLOW_LAUNCH_TOOLS`/`call_llm`/`spawn_session` (869,872,1398,1401) reference only snake-both-sides tools (no divergence). **Audit action:** confirm no set lists *only* a snake divergent form; today none do.
- **Subagent/mini-agent tool grants** — `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/runtime-agent-definition.ts:50-113` `PI_RUNTIME_AGENT_TOOL_ALIASES` already resolves each alias to **all three** spellings (`['mcp__session__CronCreate','mcp__session__cron_create','cron_create']`, `todowrite`, `reportfindings`, etc.). **Robust by construction** — subagent `tools:` lists match regardless of the switch.
- **UI rendering** — `packages/ui/src/lib/tool-parsers.ts:433` `normalizeToolCommandName` does `raw.slice('mcp__session__'.length)` (prefix strip, suffix-agnostic); `task-checklist.ts:37` explicitly handles "bare or `mcp__session__`-prefixed"; the only exact-match UI cases (`mcp__session__call_llm` at `tool-parsers.ts:356`, `TurnCard.tsx:598,1080`) are on a non-divergent snake tool. **No breakage** for divergent tools. Old snake transcripts still render (prefix strip works on any suffix).
- **Slash-command dispatch** — routed by `slash_command` handler, not by the wire name; Codex sends session commands "BARE" (`codex-agent.ts:656`). Unaffected.
- **Guardian** (`guardian-consult.ts`, `guardian-judge-core.ts`) — grep found **no** session-tool-name literals; the judge classifies by permissionName/effect via the descriptor, not `piName`. Unaffected.

---

## HARD vs SOFT summary

- **HARD (only one):** old on-disk Pi session transcripts (`.pi-sessions/*.jsonl`) carrying snake piNames — becomes a resume-time name mismatch **unless** `pi-legacy-ingress.ts` is inverted+extended. With that single mitigation it downgrades to SOFT.
- **SOFT / controlled:** ~10 golden test files (static-registry assertions), the `pi-runtime-protocol.test.ts:218` "diverge on purpose" rationale, any embedded manifest-hash fixtures. All regenerate predictably.
- **No-op (insulated):** permissions, pre-tool-use gates, guardian, subagent tool grants, UI parsers, slash dispatch, the `bindingName`-keyed definition lookup, and the model-contract hash (no static pins for session tools).

**Net:** the change itself is ~1 line in `harness-tool-descriptor.ts` (`sessionBinding` uses `handlerName` for `piName`); the risk is entirely in (1) the transcript compat bridge and (2) a bounded golden-test refresh. There is **no** bare↔prefixed hard break because Pi was never bare.

**Anchor files:** `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/harness-tool-descriptor.ts:234-363` (the mint), `packages/pi-agent-server/src/harness/tool-manifest.ts:287,388,397` (projection + hash), `packages/pi-agent-server/src/compat/pi-legacy-ingress.ts:5-13` (the one HARD seam), `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-harness/runtime-agent-definition.ts:50-113` (alias robustness), `packages/shared/src/agent/core/pre-tool-use.ts:125-145,869-878` (policy-name insulation), `packages/ui/src/lib/tool-parsers.ts:433`, `packages/codex-responses-adapter/src/config-writer.ts:613` (Codex `nessy_session` third-divergence flag).

# PLAN DRAFT — Unify session-tool wire names to the Claude SDK form (`mcp__session__<RegistryId>`)

> Premise correction the planner must fold in before formatting: the input GOAL says "Pi sends BARE names (source_manage, TodoWrite…)". That is **false on HEAD (1.25.1)**. Pi's model-facing name is already `mcp__session__<descriptorId>` (snake), minted at `harness-tool-descriptor.ts:253-259` and installed at `tool-manifest.ts:388`. The whole plan is scoped to that.

## 1. GOAL and non-goals

**Goal.** Make every SESSION tool carry a byte-identical model-facing wire name across Pi, Claude, and Codex, equal to the Claude Agent SDK form `mcp__session__<RegistryId>`, where `<RegistryId>` is the canonical `SESSION_TOOL_DEFS` id verbatim (`tool-defs.ts:1046-1170`). Claude is already at the target (`createSdkMcpServer({name:'session'})` + `tool(def.name,…)`, `session-scoped-tools.ts:266-284,330`). Two edits reach parity:
- **Pi**: stop snake-casing the projected name — make `piName` use the handler/registry id, not the snake `descriptorId`.
- **Codex**: rename the bundled MCP server config key `nessy_session` → `session`, so the binary mints `mcp__session__<id>` instead of `mcp__nessy_session__<id>`.

**Non-goals (explicit).**
- **Integrations / plugins / dp / source-pool MCP names are already unified** across the three runtimes (single mint) — out of scope, do not touch.
- **Native SDK built-ins** (Bash, Read, Edit, Glob/Find, Grep, WebFetch, Agent/subagent, TodoWrite-as-native, NotebookEdit, …) ride bare on all runtimes and are **not** session tools. Their Pi bindings deliberately keep `piName ≠ bindingName` (e.g. `binding('notebook_edit','notebook_edit','NotebookEdit',…)`, `harness-tool-descriptor.ts:288`). **Do not touch native bindings or the manifest union rule that serves them.**
- **The permission/hook layer stays bare.** Rules and hooks match `permissionName`/`descriptorId` (`permissions-config.ts:529`, `pi-agent-server/src/index.ts:2281-2287`), never `piName`. This plan does not change permission-rule grammar.
- **Pi-only tools** (Task*/Goal*/Monitor/EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree/Cron*/PushNotification/ScheduleWakeup/list_mcp_resources/read_mcp_resource) have no cross-runtime counterpart, so parity does not require them — but the chosen Pi fix renames them too, as a free consequence of a single-function change (see §2). That is acceptable and desirable (internal consistency).
- **The llm-proxy / platform-side allowlist registration is out of scope** — named as a downstream dependency in §6, not folded in.

## 2. Approach and rejected alternatives

**Chosen approach: collapse Pi's `piName` onto `bindingName`, and rename the Codex server key. No shim on the live wire; one inbound compat map for old transcripts.**

Pi's `sessionBinding` today (`harness-tool-descriptor.ts:253-259`):

```
const sessionBinding = (descriptorId, handlerName) => binding(
  descriptorId,
  `mcp__session__${descriptorId}`,   // piName  — model sees SNAKE
  `mcp__session__${handlerName}`,    // bindingName — host↔subprocess uses REGISTRY ID
  handlerName, handlerName,
)
```

`handlerName` is already the exact Claude/Codex registry id for all 55 session tools (verified: `sessionBinding('todo_write','TodoWrite')`, `sessionBinding('submit_plan','SubmitPlan')`, … `harness-tool-descriptor.ts:295-362`; Claude's `tool(def.name,…)` uses the same `def.name`, `session-scoped-tools.ts:280-284`). So the fix is one line — make `piName` use `handlerName`:

```
const sessionBinding = (descriptorId, handlerName) => binding(
  descriptorId,
  `mcp__session__${handlerName}`,    // piName == bindingName == Claude form
  `mcp__session__${handlerName}`,
  handlerName, handlerName,
)
```

This is low-risk **because the internal registration key already uses the registry-id spelling**: the definition lookup keys on `bindingName` (`tool-manifest.ts:287`, unchanged), and session tools carry **no static model-contract pin** — `PI_STATIC_MODEL_CONTRACT_HASHES` (`harness-tool-descriptor.ts:45-71`) lists only native/orchestrator tools; **verified, no `mcp__session__*` key present**. Session-tool hashes are computed per-session by `hashProjectedPiToolDefinition` over `projected.name` (=piName), on both host and subprocess from the same registry, so the digest moves **consistently on both sides** — no "manifest model contract mismatch" wall and no pin to regenerate.

For Codex, the model-facing name is `mcp__${server}__${tool}` where `server` is the config key (`event-adapter.ts:148` `mcpRowToolName`), set as the literal `[mcp_servers.nessy_session]` at `config-writer.ts:613`. Renaming that literal to `[mcp_servers.session]` moves Codex onto `mcp__session__<id>` and — bonus — makes the UI prefix-strip fire for Codex too (`tool-parsers.ts:433` strips only `mcp__session__`).

**Alternatives weighed and rejected:**

- **(a) Emit `mcp__session__` at the wire layer + a live inbound shim accepting the old bare/snake spellings on the permission/hook/transcript paths during a transition.** Rejected as over-built: the permission layer never saw `piName` (it matches `permissionName`), so there is nothing to shim there; and a live dual-accept on the model wire is unnecessary because nothing on `master` mints the *bare* form and the snake→registry-id move is internal to Pi. The only place old spellings genuinely arrive is replayed on-disk history — handled by the one inbound map in option (b), not a standing shim. A permanent dual-name accept is exactly the kind of "wildcard seatbelt" the repo's inert-worklist warns against carrying past its need.

- **(b, chosen) Pure projection rename + a bounded transcript-migration on ingress.** The rename is projection-only (host internals and the definition-lookup key already use the registry-id spelling). The single backward-compat seam is `pi-legacy-ingress.ts` (§4). This is the smallest change that reaches parity and stays green.

- **(c) Translate only at Pi's manifest projection, leaving `descriptorId`/`piName` snake internally and mapping to registry-id at the boundary.** Rejected: this is what exists today (piName is a projection), and it is *the divergence itself*. Adding a second projection layer on top doubles the name-mapping surface (`presentedName` already accepts two spellings, `tool-manifest.ts:39-58`) for no benefit, and every consumer that hashes/normalizes `projected.name` would still see snake. More code, same or worse blast radius, no parity.

Concurrent-edit trap: `runtime-agent-definitions.ts` + `.test.ts` are **already modified in the working tree** on this branch — Task 1 must not also edit them (it doesn't need to; see §4 alias robustness), and any executor touching them must serialize by-file.

## 4. Backward-compat decision (made explicit)

**Old on-disk sessions must still render and resume.** Two disk formats exist:

- **Pi `.pi-sessions/*.jsonl`** recorded the snake `piName` (`mcp__session__submit_plan`) in `toolCall` blocks. On resume they pass through `normalizePiSdkToolCallRecordsV1` (`pi-legacy-ingress.ts`), whose `TOOL_NAME_ALIASES` today maps **Pascal→snake** and covers **only 5** tools (`SubmitPlan/TodoWrite/Task/SlashCommand/BashOutput`). **Decision:** in Task 1, **invert the map to snake→Pascal** (`mcp__session__submit_plan → mcp__session__SubmitPlan`, …) and **extend it to the full divergent set** — every tool whose `descriptorId ≠ handlerName`: SubmitPlan, TodoWrite, Task, TaskCreate/Update/Get/List, GoalGet, Goal, SlashCommand, BashOutput, ProcessStop, Monitor, EnterWorktree, ExitWorktree, ReportFindings, PushNotification, SendUserFile, CronCreate/List/Delete, ScheduleWakeup (derive the list programmatically from `PI_TOOL_BINDINGS` where `descriptorId !== handlerName`, so it can never drift — do not hand-maintain). This normalizes old snake history *forward* to the new live spelling, so a resumed session shows one consistent name across turns. This is the single HARD seam; with this edit it is SOFT.
- **UI rendering** of any old transcript is suffix-agnostic already (`tool-parsers.ts:433` strips the prefix, any suffix), so old snake names render correctly with no change; Task 3 additionally recovers old Codex `nessy_session` rows.

**No transcript rewrite on disk** — normalization is read-time only, preserving the append-only history contract.

## 5. Repo-specific risks and traps

- **Two production bugs already came from upstream tool renames** (AGENTS.md: `Task`→`Agent`; Claude LSP `input.lsp`→`lspServers`). This change is the same failure class (a rename), so the guard is the **direct parity unit test in Task 1** that asserts Pi piName == Claude SDK name for every cross-visible tool, computed from the live registries — not a hardcoded table. That test is the regression fence.
- **The manifest digest is not hand-written.** Verified session tools carry no static pin (`PI_STATIC_MODEL_CONTRACT_HASHES` has no `mcp__session__*`), so there is no pin to regenerate and no host/subprocess mismatch — but the plan must **not** add one, and Task 1's gate should assert host and subprocess `modelContractHash` agree for a renamed tool (they read the same registry). If any snapshot fixture embeds a session-tool hash, regenerate it in the same commit.
- **Permission-rule pattern matching is insulated** — rules match `permissionName`/`descriptorId`, never `piName` (`permissions-config.ts:529`, built from `PERMISSION_RULE_TOOL_NAMES` = permissionName+descriptorId). Confirm no user-facing rule doc tells users to write `mcp__session__todo_write`; if one does, it was already wrong for the wire and stays a permission-name doc.
- **Guardian** carries no session-tool-name literals (grep clean; it classifies by descriptor effect/permissionName) — no change, but include `guardian-consult.ts`/`guardian-judge-core.ts` in the `grep -a` sweep to keep the negative honest.
- **pre-tool-use classifiers** are fed `permissionName`, not `piName` (`pre-tool-use.ts:125-145` comment), and the name-literal sets that reference the wire form already list *both* spellings (`ENTER_WORKTREE_TOOLS` at `:877-878` has `mcp__session__EnterWorktree` AND `…enter_worktree`). **Audit action, not edit:** confirm no set references *only* a snake divergent form; today none do — but this is exactly a "getter/setter" style miss, so verify with `grep -a` for each divergent snake literal across `pre-tool-use.ts`.

No change needed — and this file is **already modified in the working tree**, so Task 1 must leave it alone (concurrent-edit / `git commit <pathspec>` trap).

Re-verify in Task 2's config-writer test by asserting the full emitted TOML has exactly one `[mcp_servers.session]`.

## 6. Relationship to the deferred llm-proxy allowlist registration (dependency, not folded in)

The gateway/llm-proxy allowlist work (MEMORY: "llm-proxy: каталог ≠ доступ", "Personal-key flow") needs a canonical list of host-executed tool names to register as allowed on the proxy side. **Today that list would be three per-runtime spellings** (`mcp__session__todo_write` / `mcp__session__TodoWrite` / `mcp__nessy_session__TodoWrite`), which cannot be registered as one set. **After this plan lands, `getToolDefsAsJsonSchema({prefix:'mcp__session__'})` yields ONE canonical wire-name list** identical on all three runtimes — the single registrable session-tool list the proxy plan needs. This plan is a **precondition** for that registration; it does **not** implement the platform-side allowlist call (a separate, server-owned plan). State the hand-off: "unified naming produces one `mcp__session__*` list; proxy-side registration consumes it downstream."
